about.quote: A preference for transcendence and taboo
about.bio:
Graham Cooper is a director and editor. He holds a Master's Degree from the David Lynch School of Cinematic Arts.

His work spans commercial and narrative filmmaking with a focus on character-driven storytelling.

He is currently finishing his feature film debut, due out later this year.

spring.title: One Afternoon in Spring
spring.intro:
One trailer a year, every year, from 2022 until the film is finished.
What it's about is still being found.

creeker.title: Creeker Day
creeker.intro:
Every July 4th, people send me footage of their day, and I cut it into one film.
It's been the holiday since 2017.
